inline.description: rhythm/inline: between elements side by side, such as the actions of a row (gap-inline).

title-content.description: rhythm/title-content: between a title and its content (gap-title-content).

label-control.description: rhythm/label-control: between the label of a field and its control (gap-label-control).

between-containers.description: rhythm/between-containers: between containers with a boundary, such as the cards of a set (gap-between-containers).

between-fields.description: rhythm/between-fields: between the fields of a form (gap-between-fields).

inset.description: rhythm/inset: inside a container of a part, such as a card or a banner, shared by its regions (p-inset).

between-groups.description: rhythm/between-groups: between the groups of fields of a form (gap-between-groups).

between-sections.description: rhythm/between-sections: between the sections of a page (gap-between-sections).

reading.description: widths/reading: the measure of text to read, 65 to 80 characters on a full line.

form.description: widths/form: the column of a form, the measure of the text around it (max-w-form).

page.description: widths/page: the largest width of the content of a page, the frame mds-header-bar shares (page-frame).

page-gutter.description: widths/page: the space between the edge of the window and the frame of the page (page-frame).

dialog.description: widths/dialog: the window of a dialog, the column of a form plus its inset.
